clue.text: Disregard holy men born in Settle

indicators.note: the saints and the birth abbreviation are placed inside the word for settling a bill

parts.note: to settle a bill is to pay it
SS is the abbreviation for saints
B is the abbreviation for born in genealogies

explanation.surface: Ignoring the priests who were born in a Yorkshire town.
explanation.walkthrough: Settle is also a town in North Yorkshire, which steers the reader away from the verb meaning to pay.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass someone by is to take no notice of them, which is to ignore them.

clue.text: Drunk chose to drink litres

indicators.note: the selection word swallows the litres letter

parts.note: picked means chose

explanation.surface: An inebriated person opted to down a few litres.
explanation.definitionFit: Pickled is slang for intoxicated, preserved in alcohol as it were.

clue.text: Fiend convened with a bridge partner

parts.note: a committee sat when it convened
taken as written
in bridge the players are North, South, East and West, so N is one partner

explanation.surface: A devil gathered at the card table with a partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Satan is the Devil, the chief evil spirit, so a fiend.

clue.text: Shakespearean drink cheers

parts.note: Bottom is the weaver in A Midsummer Night's Dream
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: A toast raised over a drink from the works of Shakespeare.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as BOTTOM SUP, Shakespeare's character drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A drinking toast urging everyone to empty their glasses, like saying cheers.

clue.text: Crushed fabric

definitions.meaning: crushed in the sense of beaten soundly, defeated
a smooth woollen cloth made from twisted yarn

explanation.definitionFit: Worsted is an old verb for defeated and also the name of a fine wool cloth.

clue.text: Women listen to the French charm

parts.note: to heed is to listen to and take notice of
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Ladies heed the Gallic allure.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheedle is to coax or persuade by flattery, to charm into something.

clue.text: A grand in sterling is magnificent

indicators.note: the thousand letter goes inside the word for genuine

parts.note: sterling as an adjective means genuine, real
G is slang for a grand, a thousand pounds

explanation.surface: A thousand pounds in British money is splendid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sterling' suggests British currency but here means genuine or of good quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Regal means kingly, fit for a monarch, hence splendid and magnificent.

clue.text: Customs making sad idiot rant

indicators.note: sad in the sense of sorry or wretched, so the letters are in a poor state and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Traditions that make a miserable fool rave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sad' looks like part of the fodder, but the nine letters of IDIOT RANT are what get rearranged; 'making' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradition is a long-established custom handed down through generations.

clue.text: Representative sets record in commission

indicators.note: the disc sits inside the word for a task

parts.note: a duty is a task one is commissioned to do
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: An agent lays down a disc while on an assignment.
explanation.definitionFit: A deputy acts on behalf of another, representing them.

clue.text: Destiny of sovereign is fulfilled

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king
taken as written
to meet a requirement is to fulfil it

explanation.surface: The fate of a king is achieved.
explanation.definitionFit: Kismet is fate, from Turkish and Arabic, the destiny allotted to someone.

clue.text: Allow little margin to cook fettucini

indicators.note: to cook figuratively is to doctor or tamper with, so the pasta's letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Instructions to cook pasta with hardly any time to spare.
explanation.walkthrough: The kitchen picture makes 'cook' look literal; it is the anagram signal on FETTUCINI.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for leaving almost no time or room to spare when doing something.

clue.text: Old monarch gets snake to hold

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
an asp is a venomous snake

explanation.surface: An ancient king takes a serpent in his hand.
explanation.walkthrough: GR is the cipher of King George, seen on old British postboxes.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp something is to seize and keep a firm hold of it.

clue.text: Orchestra leader followed fast time in slow movement

indicators.note: the orchestra's first letter comes after the period of fasting

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: The orchestra's leader keeps up with a quick tempo during a slow passage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fast time' looks like a musical tempo, but it is the period of fasting before Easter. In an orchestra the leader is the principal violinist, which adds to the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning to be played slowly, so it names a slow movement or passage.

clue.text: Prizewinner introduces director to food programme

indicators.note: the food word takes the director's letter into its middle

parts.note: a meal is food eaten at one sitting
a list of items is a programme or schedule

explanation.surface: An award winner brings a director onto a cookery show.
explanation.definitionFit: A medallist has won a medal, a prize for success in a contest.

clue.text: Absolutely determined to join exhausted group

parts.note: dead tired, completely worn out
a set is a group of things or people

explanation.surface: Someone resolved to join a club despite being worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: To be dead set on something is to be firmly resolved upon it.

clue.text: Married man who later rued arrangement?

indicators.note: an arrangement of letters is a rearrangement of them

explanation.surface: A husband who regretted an affair afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An adulterer is a married person unfaithful to their spouse.

clue.text: Occasion where hospital department has trouble

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: An event at which a hospital ward is having difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Occasion' reads as a noun, an event, but is the verb meaning to bring about.
explanation.definitionFit: To occasion something is to cause it, as one consequence necessarily involves another.

clue.text: Casual worker on counter can be seduced

parts.note: a temp is a temporary worker
a table is a counter or flat surface

explanation.surface: A temporary employee at the shop counter is easily tempted.
explanation.definitionFit: Temptable means open to temptation, able to be lured or seduced.

clue.text: Representative in power in disorder

indicators.note: the politician sits inside the word for authority

parts.note: rule is power or dominion
an MP, Member of Parliament, represents a constituency

explanation.surface: An elected official in office amid chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' looks like a noun after 'in', but it is the verb meaning to make untidy.
explanation.definitionFit: To rumple hair or clothes is to make them untidy and creased.

clue.text: Is a Celt prepared to be resilient?

indicators.note: prepared in the sense of made up or processed, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Asks whether a Gaelic person is ready to bounce back.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic materials spring back into shape, as resilient ones do.

clue.text: Self-righteous people finally uproot old plant

parts.note: pi is slang for sanctimonious, short for pious
men are people

indicators.note: the final letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Sanctimonious folk eventually rip out an ancient shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: The sweet red pepper is a cultivated plant of the capsicum family.

clue.text: Food Troy cut away from bone

indicators.note: the troy letter is removed from the bone word

parts.note: the patella is the kneecap bone
T is an abbreviation for troy weight

explanation.surface: A dish in which a city's meat is carved off the bone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Troy' suggests the ancient city or a name, but it is troy weight, abbreviated T.
explanation.definitionFit: Paella is a Spanish dish of saffron rice with seafood or meat.

clue.text: Hold cap awkwardly for squire

indicators.note: the letters are handled clumsily, so they end up rearranged

explanation.surface: Fumbling with one's hat when greeting the lord of the manor.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'old chap' and 'squire' are matey British forms of address between men.
explanation.definitionFit: Squire is a familiar British way of addressing a man, as is old chap.

clue.text: Former PM had a hand in constitution

indicators.note: the former premier holds the hand letter within him

parts.note: Edward Heath was UK Prime Minister 1970 to 1974
L stands for left, one hand

explanation.surface: An ex-prime minister played a part in drafting the constitution.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Heath was a British Conservative prime minister; 'constitution' means bodily condition, not a political document.
explanation.definitionFit: One's constitution is one's physical makeup, one's state of health.

clue.text: Staff measure journey time

parts.note: an en is a printers' measure of width
a tour is a journey
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Employees gauge how long a trip will take.
explanation.definitionFit: An entourage is the group of attendants or staff accompanying an important person.

clue.text: Trouble riding mount

parts.note: a jockey who is up is riding a horse
to set a jewel is to mount it

explanation.surface: Difficulty getting onto a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: To upset someone is to trouble or distress them.

clue.text: Edward keeps relationship lukewarm

indicators.note: the short name holds the ratio inside it

parts.note: Ted is a short form of Edward
pi is a fixed ratio, the relationship of a circle's circumference to its diameter

explanation.surface: Edward maintains a romance that has cooled.
explanation.definitionFit: Tepid water is only slightly warm, and a tepid response is half-hearted.

clue.text: Outstanding reminder about university

indicators.note: the nudge word goes round the university letter

parts.note: a prod is a nudge or reminder

explanation.surface: An excellent note prompting someone about college.
explanation.definitionFit: Proud can mean projecting above a surface, standing out, so outstanding.

clue.text: Sailor isn't exhibiting forest dweller

indicators.note: the letters are on display within the words of the phrase

explanation.surface: A seaman is not putting on a show of a woodland creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The loris is a slow-moving primate living in tropical forests of Asia.

clue.text: Ring Mrs Blair professionally where charge is made

parts.note: to toll a bell is to ring it
Cherie Blair practises as a barrister under her maiden name, Booth

explanation.surface: A phone call to the former PM's wife about her legal fees.
explanation.walkthrough: Cherie Blair, wife of the UK prime minister Tony Blair, is a barrister known professionally as Cherie Booth.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiosk at a road or bridge where drivers pay a fee to pass.

clue.text: Dissident now gets credit cut

parts.note: here can mean at this point, now

indicators.note: the word loses its final letter

parts.note: on tick means on credit

explanation.surface: A rebel now finds his borrowing limit reduced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' removes the last letter of TICK to leave TIC; 'on tick' is British slang for buying on credit.
explanation.definitionFit: A heretic holds opinions at odds with accepted doctrine, a dissenter.

clue.text: Society to arrive for burlesque

parts.note: to end up somewhere is to arrive there finally

explanation.surface: The upper classes turn up for a comic stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: A send-up is a parody or satirical imitation, which is what a burlesque is.
